CRLR No.664 of 2025
With
(Stay Appl. No.01 of 2025)
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mrs. Neetu Singh, learned counsel for the 
revisionist.
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State. 
3. Admit. 
4. Issue notice to respondent no.2.
5. Steps to be taken within one week.
6. Let the objection be filed by the State within 
two weeks.
7. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits 
that the present matter has arisen from trivial 
dispute that can be settled amicably and the parties 
may be called for the same. 
8. List on 30.12.2025.
9. As an interim measure till the next date of 
listing effect and operation of order dated 
11.07.2025 passed by the Additional Principal 
Judge, Family Court, Rishikesh, District Dehradun 
in Case No.68 of 2023 Smt. Preeti Yadav vs. 
Shubham Yadav shall remain stayed subject to the 
condition that revisionist shall deposit 20% of the 
arrear amount within two weeks. 
10. Stay application stands disposed of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 10.11.2025
